body.x: HearDL LLC (CEO Hong June Park) has announced its participation in CES 2025, from January 7 to 10, in Las Vegas, where it will exhibit in the K-Startup Pavilion.

Established in 2022 by a professor emeritus of electronics and electrical engineering at POSTECH and two developers, HearDL focuses on providing affordable, high-performance hearing assistance devices powered by AI. The company has developed a real-time captioning hearing aid app that connects regular wireless earbuds to smartphones.

The app uses AI to eliminate background noise, amplify sounds tailored to the user’s hearing profile, and deliver them to wireless earbuds. Simultaneously, it transcribes speech into text in real-time on the smartphone screen, enabling users to communicate more effectively by leveraging auditory and visual cues.

In May 2024, HearDL launched a Korean-language version of the hearing aid app for Android smartphones. Since then, the company has enhanced the algorithm and sound quality, adding real-time captioning to transcribe spoken words directly onto the screen. This updated version will be demonstrated as an English-language hearing aid app for Android smartphones at CES 2025.
By showcasing the English-language app, HearDL aims to gather feedback from English-speaking users and explore early investment opportunities with international investors.

Regarding plans, HearDL stated, “We plan to develop an iOS version of the English-language app, followed by Korean and Spanish versions for both Android and iOS platforms. Additionally, we aim to execute AI programs on semiconductor chips rather than smartphones, enabling us to design chips necessary for manufacturing OTC hearing aids and outsource their production.”
